info.title: DOC shell (TypeScript), waves 1-3
info.description: Experimental TypeScript shell running beside DOC's FastAPI. Endpoints 1-7 of the stack report's table.

DocumentRequest.description: DOC's DocumentRequest; validated by the core with DOC's rules (422 in the legacy body when invalid).

TaskStatus.description: state is one of PENDING, DOC's stage strings, SUCCESS or FAILURE. An unknown task id is PENDING (Celery's behaviour, kept).

attempt.description: From the second attempt on: which attempt is running (the state stays at the last stage reached).

result.description: The document request key: the files are `<key>.docx`, `<key>.html`, `<key>.pdf`.

schema.description: `1` answers HTTP 503 (same body) when the status is not ok, for a load balancer.

parameters.description: `1` answers HTTP 503 (same body) when the status is not ok, for a load balancer.
parameters.name: strict

200.description: `[{"status":"ok"},200]` (a FastAPI quirk, kept) with the queue, Redis, workers, docx pool, catalog and disk added when the job queue is configured

503.description: Only with `?strict=1` and a status that is not ok
